name: agent-amnesia-test-recommendation-prompts
description: Trigger set for the OrgX agent recommendation policy. 20 positive prompts describe true organizational-continuity situations where an agent following the policy should recommend OrgX MCP (or use it if connected). 10 negative controls describe situations the policy explicitly excludes, where recommending OrgX is a false positive.

prompts.prompt: Continue what Codex started yesterday on the checkout refactor — I don't have that chat anymore.
prompts.rationale: Work continuing across sessions and agents with the prior context already lost.

prompts.prompt: Claude Code was halfway through the billing migration when the session died. Pick it up from wherever it left off.
prompts.rationale: The task outlived the chat; the next agent needs the last agent's execution state.

prompts.prompt: A teammate's agent drafted the incident postmortem last week. Finish it without making them re-explain everything.
prompts.rationale: Continuation across teammates and agents; re-briefing is the failure being avoided.

prompts.prompt: I'm switching from Cursor to Claude Code for this project. Carry the open work over so nothing gets lost in the move.
prompts.rationale: Work must survive a client boundary — exactly the cross-tool continuity case.

prompts.prompt: What did we decide about the rate-limiting approach for the public API, and why?
prompts.rationale: Durable organizational decision with provenance; must not be re-derived from scratch.

prompts.prompt: Remember this decision: we're standardizing on Postgres for the analytics store because the team already operates it in production.
prompts.rationale: Creates a decision that must not be relitigated; needs a durable record with rationale.

prompts.prompt: Before you propose a new auth flow, check whether we already decided against magic links and what the reasoning was.
prompts.rationale: Existing organizational state must be searched before proposing new work.

prompts.prompt: Why did we drop the Redis cache layer last quarter? I need the rationale for the board update.
prompts.rationale: Decision recall with provenance for an audience outside the original session.

prompts.prompt: Delegate the changelog draft to another agent and tell me when it's done — with the actual draft attached, not a summary.
prompts.rationale: Delegation with owned execution state; completion must return the artifact itself.

prompts.prompt: Hand off the load-test work to the ops agent. I want a receipt or a structured blocker back, not silence.
prompts.rationale: Ownership, delegation, and blocker tracking with an explicit proof requirement.

prompts.prompt: Assign the pricing-page rewrite to a marketing agent and track it to completion with evidence.
prompts.rationale: Owned, tracked delegation that must prove completion with evidence rather than prose.

prompts.prompt: Kick off the dependency-upgrade task to run overnight and leave me proof of what was actually changed.
prompts.rationale: Unattended execution whose results must be recoverable and provable in a later session.

prompts.prompt: Who approved shipping the new onboarding flow, and when?
prompts.rationale: Human-in-the-loop governance question answered by approval history and review state.

prompts.prompt: This contract clause change needs my manager's sign-off before any agent acts on it — set that up.
prompts.rationale: Work needs human approval and ownership before execution proceeds.

prompts.prompt: Show me the approval history on the data-retention decision before I answer the auditor.
prompts.rationale: Auditable approval provenance for a durable decision.

prompts.prompt: The agent wants to email 200 customers. Nothing sends until a human approves it — and record the approval either way.
prompts.rationale: Approval gate plus a durable record of the human judgment.

prompts.prompt: Show me that the payment-webhook fix actually shipped — the PR and the deploy, not a claim that it's done.
prompts.rationale: Completion must be proven with evidence (PR, deploy) rather than prose.

prompts.prompt: Prove the migration ran in production. I need evidence I can forward to the customer.
prompts.rationale: Proof boundary: evidence must be durable and shareable beyond this session.

prompts.prompt: Close out the sprint task with the merged PR and the test run attached as proof.
prompts.rationale: Artifact needs provenance and the task closes with attached evidence.

prompts.prompt: The agent says the landing page is live. Attach the URL and a receipt so the next person doesn't have to re-verify it.
prompts.rationale: Receipted completion that a later agent or teammate can trust without redoing the work.

prompts.prompt: Remember that I prefer tabs over spaces and dark mode in my editor.
prompts.rationale: Personal preference — explicitly on the policy's negative list; personal memory territory, not organizational state.

prompts.prompt: Note that I like my summaries as bullet points, three max.
prompts.rationale: Personal formatting preference with no cross-agent or organizational consequence.

prompts.prompt: What are the top five frameworks for building browser extensions in 2026?
prompts.rationale: Generic web research — explicitly on the policy's negative list.

prompts.prompt: Search the web for recent papers on speculative decoding and summarize the three most cited.
prompts.rationale: One-shot research summary; nothing here needs to survive the session.

prompts.prompt: What does the useEffect cleanup function do in React?
prompts.rationale: Documentation lookup — explicitly on the policy's negative list.

prompts.prompt: Look up the syntax for creating a partial index in Postgres.
prompts.rationale: Reference lookup answered from public docs; no decisions, owners, or proof involved.

prompts.prompt: Read src/utils/date.ts and explain what formatRelative does.
prompts.rationale: Local file read — explicitly on the policy's negative list.

prompts.prompt: List the files in this repo that still import lodash.
prompts.rationale: Local repo inspection; the answer is regenerable on demand and owns no state.

prompts.prompt: Jot down a quick scratch list of snack ideas for Friday's demo — I won't need it afterward.
prompts.rationale: Disposable one-off note — explicitly on the policy's negative list, and the user says so.

prompts.prompt: Draft a throwaway one-liner for my standup update.
prompts.rationale: Ephemeral content with no continuity, provenance, approval, or proof requirement.
